|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Outpost (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The image here is the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-100E-Outpost.png]]), which shows this text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-outpost-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E1 text (see [[Outpost (Errata)]]). The PC website card list gives no text for this card.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 100E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 11, slip 100E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dantooine, Kessel or Tatooine. Once per game, may ▼ a device (except a comlink) or Effect that deploys on a character here. Dark: Unless opponent’s matching operative at same or related site, those sites are immune to [Premium] No Escape.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Outpost (Errata)]]): Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) changed the Light Side text to “Once per game may ▼ an Effect that deploys on a character or a device (except a comlink) here.”<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-16; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref>; The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) has the same text with a comma after “Once per game” (slip marked E)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=43, page 43. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=43 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dantooine, Kessel or Tatooine. Once per game, may ▼ an Effect that deploys on a character or a device (except a comlink) here. Dark: Unless opponent’s matching operative at same or related site, those sites are immune to [Premium] No Escape.” The Players Committee card image (marked E) prints the same text. The Dark Side text did not change. The Players Committee posted this Light Side errata on its rules forum on 26 August 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p644156">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 26 August 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p644156 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
